instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Rank rows by cost within each dept
output: SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY cost DESC) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Dense rank of rows by cost
output: SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cost DESC) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Row number per dept ordered by incurred_on
output: SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY incurred_on) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Running total of cost ordered by incurred_on
output: SELECT *, SUM(cost) OVER (ORDER BY incurred_on) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Running total of cost per dept
output: SELECT *, SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY incurred_on) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Average of cost over all rows
output: SELECT *, AVG(cost) OVER () FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Previous cost value (lag) per dept
output: SELECT *, LAG(cost, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY incurred_on) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Next cost value (lead) per dept
output: SELECT *, LEAD(cost, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY incurred_on) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Maximum cost per dept across all rows
output: SELECT *, MAX(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY dept) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Minimum cost per dept
output: SELECT *, MIN(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY dept) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Moving average window of 3 rows per dept
output: SELECT *, AVG(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY incurred_on ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Window frame from first row to current per dept
output: SELECT *, SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY incurred_on ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
First value of cost per dept
output: SELECT *, FIRST_VALUE(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY incurred_on) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Last value of cost per dept across full partition
output: SELECT *, LAST_VALUE(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY incurred_on ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Percent rank of cost
output: SELECT *, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cost) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Cumulative distribution of cost
output: SELECT *, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY cost) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Quartile bucket using NTILE
output: SELECT *, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY cost) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Difference of cost from its group max
output: SELECT dept, cost, cost - MAX(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY dept) AS diff FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Rank of cost with ties allowed to skip
output: SELECT dept, cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cost DESC) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Sliding window of total over preceding 5 rows
output: SELECT *, SUM(cost) OVER (ORDER BY incurred_on ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Running count per dept
output: SELECT *, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY incurred_on) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Top 2 by cost within each dept using ROW_NUMBER
output: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY cost DESC) rn FROM expenses) x WHERE rn <= 2;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Nth value of cost within partition
output: SELECT *, NTH_VALUE(cost, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY incurred_on ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Expressed ratio of cost to group total
output: SELECT dept, cost, cost / SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY dept) AS ratio FROM expenses;

instruction:
Schema: expenses(dept, cost, incurred_on)
Window with custom unbounded following frame
output: SELECT *, SUM(cost) OVER (PARTITION BY dept ORDER BY incurred_on ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) FROM expenses;
